plan.archetype: Flexible AoE offense, poison scaling, and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring early AoE, sustained damage, upgraded defense or Weak, and useful potions. Preserve enough health to establish scaling against all three enemies.
plan.summary: Prioritize immediate damage and AoE before adding conditional synergies. Build sustained offense and efficient defense, remove Strikes, and attempt elites only with strong damage, health, and potions.

plan.archetype: AoE control with poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with upgraded Haze, repeatable AoE, poison scaling, and improved defense. Save a useful potion for dangerous turns.

plan.archetype: AoE poison control with sustained scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Mulligan for Haze+, Fasten, and Echoing Slash. Eliminate followers promptly; poison priest. Make Haze free and triple substantial block on dangerous turns.
plan.summary: Clock uncalibrated; prioritize sustained damage, draw, and dexterity. Remove Strikes, retain Fasten-supported Defends, and upgrade Echoing Slash or core scaling. Avoid elites until stronger; favor restorative question marks.
